questions.question: The difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs. X at 7.5% per annum for 2 years is Rs. 22.50. Find the value of X.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For 2 years, the difference between **Compound Interest** and **Simple Interest** is the interest earned on the first year's interest.

Rate (R) = 7.5% = 3/40 in fraction form.

Difference = Principal × (R)² ⇒ 22.50 = X × (3/40)²

X = (22.50 × 1600) ÷ 9 ⇒ X = 2.5 × 1600 = 4000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹ **X**

Rate of Interest (R) = **7.5%** per annum

Time (T) = **2 years**

Difference (D) = ₹ **22.50**

**Formula Used:**

Difference between CI and SI for 2 years (D) = P × (R/100)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/281dd67bec3a348f0fbb95351c13602338e1b4558d0587cf0e1268f00faa42cd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ D = X × (7.5/100) × (7.5/100)

⇒ 22.50 = X × (75/1000)²

⇒ 22.50 = X × (3/40)²

⇒ 22.50 = X × 9/1600

⇒ X = (22.50 × 1600) ÷ 9

⇒ X = 2.50 × 1600

⇒ X = 4000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference for 3 Years

The difference between CI and SI for 3 years is given by: D = P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).

Effective Rate Method

For 2 years, the effective SI rate is 2R% and the effective CI rate is (2R + R²/100)%. The difference is exactly (R²/100)% of the Principal.

Compound Interest Formula

Total Amount (A) = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ, where n is the number of years. CI = A − P.

questions.question: The mean proportional between 35 and a certain number N is four times the mean proportional between 14 and 30. The number N is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Squaring the mean proportional relation directly: 35 × N = 4² × (14 × 30)

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12 = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b26030d7237b4a277e5240f0872fdd554d81df55df7a6afe6745031b89fd97c3.png] 

**Given:**

First pair of numbers = 35 and N

Second pair of numbers = 14 and 30

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional between a and b = √(a × b)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Mean proportional of 35 and N = √(35 × N)

⇒ Mean proportional of 14 and 30 = √(14 × 30) = √420

According to the given condition:

⇒ √(35 × N) = 4 × √420

Squaring both sides of the equation:

⇒ 35 × N = 16 × 420

⇒ N = (16 × 420) ÷ 35

⇒ N = 16 × 12

⇒ N = 192

**∴ The correct answer is 192.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional (or geometric mean) between two given numbers a and b is √(ab).

Third Proportional

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion (a : b :: b : c), then c is known as the third proportional, given by c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

For three distinct numbers a, b, and c, the fourth proportional x satisfies the condition a : b :: c : x, which is calculated as x = (b × c) ÷ a.

• Areas with** fertile soil and suitable climate** are likely to have a** higher population density** as they can support agriculture and other related industries.
 
 
 
• **Topography:**
 
 
• Topography refers to the physical features of the land, such as **mountains, valleys, plains, and plateaus.**
 
• People are more likely to settle in areas with** flat land and easy accessibility to water** and other resources.
 
 
 
• **Mountainous regions** may have a** lower population density** due to the difficulty in transportation and limited space for agriculture.
 
• **Water: **
 
 
• Water is a critical resource for **human survival, **and its availability determines the distribution of population.
 
• People tend to settle near water sources like** rivers, lakes, and oceans**, as they provide a source of drinking water, irrigation, and transportation.
 
• Areas with limited water resources may have a** lower population density.**
